surface: Phase 9 documentation chrome: page parts, search, playground shell, homepage metadata

sentences.zh: 复制给 AI 智能体

sentences.en: A specification an agent can act on: the import, the setup, the chosen props, the data contract and the accessibility expectation.
sentences.zh: 一份智能体可以直接照做的说明：导入方式、外围环境、所选 props、数据契约与无障碍预期。

sentences.en: No components match that. Try an export name such as Button or LineChart.
sentences.zh: 没有匹配的组件。可以试试 Button、LineChart 这样的导出名。

sentences.en: Search the whole catalogue, including charts.
sentences.zh: 搜索整个目录，包括图表。
记录在其所属家族的页面上

sentences.en: This page documents a provider or a composed surface. Its exports come from the package entry point.
sentences.zh: 这一页记录的是一个 provider 或组合式表面，它的导出来自包的入口路径。

sentences.en: Values the compiler reads from the declaration.
sentences.zh: 以下取值均由编译器从类型声明中读出。

sentences.en: This export takes no props of its own.
sentences.zh: 这个导出本身不接受任何 props。

sentences.en: A specification an agent can act on: the import path, the setup around it, and the accessibility and styling expectations that are easy to get wrong.
sentences.zh: 一份智能体可以直接照做的说明：导入路径、外围环境，以及最容易被做错的无障碍与样式预期。

sentences.en: LUC UI — one page per component
sentences.zh: LUC UI — 每个组件一页

sentences.en: A React and TypeScript design system: tokens, accessible components, spatial motion, data display and charts — documented one component at a time, in English and Simplified Chinese.
sentences.zh: 一套 React 与 TypeScript 设计系统：设计令牌、可访问的组件、空间动效、数据展示与图表——逐个组件地写成文档，中英双语。
